highlights: close to local schools and amenities
summary: A well presented two bedroom mid terrace property offered for sale with no onward chain. This property is ideal for first time buyers, investors or those looking to downsize.
description:
HALLWAY Welcoming entrance hallway offering space for a dining table and additional freestanding furniture. Stairs lead to the first floor, while providing access to the living room and kitchen.

LIVING ROOM Lounge featuring a double-glazed window to the front elevation, allowing plenty of natural light. The room benefits from laminate flooring and a feature fireplace, creating a warm and inviting living space.

KITCHEN Kitchen fitted with a range of wall and base units providing ample storage and worktop space. Includes space for a cooker and offers a practical layout.

UTILITY AREA Small utility area located at the rear door, houses room for a washer/dryer.

BEDROOM Spacious bedroom with ample room for a king size bed and free standing furniture, also houses a built in storage cupboard.

BEDROOM Second double bedroom with fitted mirrored wardrobes.

BATHROOM Bathroom fitted with a panelled bath, wash hand basin and low level WC. A double glazed frosted window provides natural light while maintaining privacy.

EXTERNALLY Externally, the property benefits from a rear yard providing useful outdoor space, a grassed front garden and on street parking available.
